messages.text: I’m checking the geometry and primary-source support for the SiW–ALLEGRO comparison, especially what can safely be said about gaps.

**SECTOR-GAP-PHYSVAL-SOURCE**, reviewed **f3ece1d6a6816c8172dfa841d63e5424730e8228**. Source contribution only; candidate drawing not yet reviewed.

Use the current nODD DD4hep exports as drawing authority:

- **SiW:** show the projective inactive corridor faithfully. It includes the 1 mm half-seams, passive 20 mm side rails, 40 mm board-edge allocation and incomplete sensor fill. It is not simply a 2 mm air crack. Internal board staggering does not remove retained carrier boundaries.
- **Our ALLEGRO-style model:** retain its **0.2 mm total steel**, actual sensitive LAr gaps, passive bath volumes, cryostat and services. A continuous LAr material bath is not a uniformly sensitive shell.
- Mark ±11.25° as **comparison guides**, not physical ALLEGRO sector boundaries. Include inclined solids originating outside the displayed angular window when they cross into it; filtering by origins would create artificial edge gaps.
- State the XY slice’s **z coordinate**. Supports/services visible in another slice may be absent here.

The primary ALLEGRO paper describes inclined absorbers with active noble liquid between absorber and electrode, avoiding the analogous ideal projective φ crack. That supports the topology explanation, not a blanket “gaps cause no problem” or uniform-response claim. [Morange, §2/Fig. 1]([external URL redacted; see source journal]).

Suggested labels:

- “Projective inactive corridor: seam, passive rails and sensor setback”
- “Sensitive LAr gaps between inclined absorber/electrode periods”
- “Comparison guide—not a module boundary”
- “Geometry illustration; energy-response uniformity not established”

Actual checks: verified all five pinned hashes; inspected DES031/032 and geometry construction; checked the public proceeding and [pinned official XML](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/blob/e1ba7bc3e0d7291ebe3f6a02abfa784f879e36cb/FCCee/ALLEGRO/compact/ALLEGRO_o1_v03/ECalBarrel_thetamodulemerged.xml), distinguishing its 0.1 mm steel proxy from nODD. No writes, native runtime or publication. Awaiting exact exported-candidate review.
